sleeping_bag.name: Cozy Sleeping Bag
sleeping_bag.reward: Sleeping bag: +1% XP per minute lying in it, up to 3%, for one hour; you become rested while in it. Student Fodder x5 across the chain.

steps.Alliance: Accept at Alexston Farmstead, Westfall (37, 50); turn in at the burnt tower south of Camp Taurajo, The Barrens (46, 74)
steps.Horde: Accept at the burnt tower south of Camp Taurajo, The Barrens (46, 74); turn in at Alexston Farmstead, Westfall (37, 50)

steps.where: Stonetalon Mountains, path NE of Sun Rock Retreat (50.9, 52.3) to the camp (40.6, 52.4)
Thoradin's Wall, cart on the Hillsbrad side (87.3, 49.6), Messenger Bag
Satchel under the Messenger Bag; reward is the Cozy Sleeping Bag

sleeping_bag.timing_note: Each character does the chain separately. One community timing put the full chain at about 1.5 hours at level 14; many plans run it at 20-26 alongside dungeon trips.
